description: First production example: WarpX/PyWarpX capillary campaign with openPMD/HDF5 raw diagnostics and guiding metrics as reduced output.

simulation.notes: The workflow does not own the physics input. The input script is expected to consume case-specific environment variables such as CAP_*.

raw_diagnostics.name: fields_openpmd
raw_diagnostics.notes: WarpX FieldDiagnostic writes openPMD HDF5 diagnostics under the configured write_dir.

analysis.name: guiding
analysis.notes: This is the first analysis adapter. It must remain replaceable by another analysis module in future campaigns.

cleanup.notes: Cleanup is manifest-driven and may only delete explicit HDF5 files after redundant validation.
